title: Dynamic Model Routing and Cascading for Efficient LLM Inference: A Survey
abstract: arXiv:2603.04445v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The rapid growth of large language models (LLMs) with diverse capabilities, costs, and domains has created a critical need for intelligent model selection at inference time. While smaller models suffice for routine queries, complex tasks demand more capable models. However, static model deployment does not account for the complexity and domain of incoming queries, leading to suboptimal performance and increased costs. Dynamic routing systems that adaptively select models based on query characteristics have emerged as a solution to this challenge.   This survey provides a systematic analysis of multi-LLM routing and cascading approaches, focusing on systems that route queries across a pool of independently trained LLMs at inference time. We cover diverse routing paradigms, including query difficulty, human preferences, clustering, uncertainty quantification, reinforcement learning, multimodality, and cascading. For each paradigm

translated_title: 面向高效大语言模型推理的动态模型路由与级联：综述
translated_abstract: 具有不同能力、成本和领域的大语言模型（LLM）的快速增长，使得在推理时进行智能模型选择成为迫切需求。虽然较小的模型足以处理常规查询，但复杂任务需要更强大的模型。然而，静态模型部署并未考虑输入查询的复杂性和领域，导致性能欠佳和成本增加。基于查询特征自适应选择模型的动态路由系统已成为应对这一挑战的解决方案。本综述对多LLM路由和级联方法进行了系统性分析，重点关注在推理时将查询路由到一组独立训练的LLM的系统。我们涵盖了多种路由范式，包括查询难度、人类偏好、聚类、不确定性量化、强化学习、多模态和级联。针对每种范式……
tldr: 该综述系统分析了在推理时根据查询特征自适应选择大语言模型的多LLM路由与级联方法，涵盖了查询难度、人类偏好、聚类、不确定性量化、强化学习、多模态等多种路由范式。
en_tdlr: This survey provides a systematic analysis of multi-LLM routing and cascading approaches that adaptively select models at inference time based on query characteristics, covering diverse routing paradigms including query difficulty, human preferences, clustering, uncertainty quantification, reinforcement learning, multimodality, and cascading.
